reuse.why: Takes its category set from the existing getFillableCategories helper shared by the other month-wide actions and uses getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the undoable/mutator registration.

duplication.why: Only the one-line income-skip guard (is_income && !isTrackingBudget) is repeated, matching how every existing month-wide action still does it.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts beside setZero/set3MonthAvg and is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: New action, handler registration, one test and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Small, consistent with siblings, and inherits any future change to which categories are fillable.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getFillableCategories rather than its own category query.

disguised_duplication.where: No copied logic beyond the pre-existing per-action income guard.
